text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...! This zaru soba is
wicked delicious~♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"To think you'd go out of your way to make it by hand from scratch...!
I'm so touched, Buena-san!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm honored.
There's plenty for seconds, so please go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I made so much food we could practically hold
a competitive eating contest! Eat as much as you like, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
T-That many!?
I'm happy, but wasn't it a lot of trouble...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No, not in the slightest!
As you can see, I'm still full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Perhaps this was
all thanks to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer introduced a new interval running routine to build up my stamina. Now, I don't even lose my breath.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"With how I am now, I might be able to make Spe-san
happy with my handmade soba...
No, I want to make her happy!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san...! Understood,
I'll gladly accept without hesitation!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Munch munch munch munch munch...! Mmm, it's delicious~♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a pace!
Feel free to keep getting seconds, okay—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even if we run out of stock,
I'll make a fresh batch of soba noodles!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure!?
Amazing...! This is like paradise~!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's all for Spe-san's smile, after all♪
